name: Pronghorn - Nicklaus Course
architects: Jack Nicklaus (Jack Nicklaus Signature course, opened 2004; Pronghorn, renamed Juniper Preserve in 2022)

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth; projects at the course, newest first: OLC_ODF_PRIVATE_FOREST_ACCORDS_2023_DESCHUTES, OR_SOUTHEAST_2023_USGS_3DEP_12_S_PRINEVILLE_MAURY, OLC_DESCHUTES_2011, DESCHUTES_2002), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 644600-647400 / y 4893000-4895800, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-pronghorn_nicklaus, dogami_dtm_ft.tif)

ortho.source: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024 (OSIP_2024_WM exportImage), JPEG at 0.5 m in four quarters of the box x 644600-647400 / y 4893000-4895800 EPSG:32610, placed by their request boxes (pipeline/intake.py ortho); fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31

world.note: PROVISIONAL (intake): bbox of the Nicklaus golf features near its 18 OSM hole lines (x 645397-646740, y 4893660-4895150) + 120 m, rounded up to 7 x 256 m, centred

scorecard_source: Greenskeeper.org, Pronghorn Golf Club (Nicklaus Course) scorecard (read 2026-10-31): tee names Blue/Black/Copper/Gold/Silver, men's ratings and slopes, pars and men's handicaps; every row adds up to its total. GolfPass (read 2026-10-31) has the same yardages for every hole under the names Tips/Black/Rust/Gold/Silver with slightly different ratings (Tips 75.0/148, Black 73.5/145, Rust 70.8/138, Gold 68.5/128, Silver 65.4/119): open item. Silver is the women's set (Silver - Ladies 70.8/131); no men's rating. Unverified (third party; no club card online).
attribution: Elevation: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Imagery check: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024

gorse.note: sagebrush and bitterbrush, not gorse: bushes from the OSIP 2024 photo (pipeline/gorse.py with the Silvies sage colour rule, V up to 150 for the paler pumice ground), 7 m apart, kept 3 m off mown grass; no penal ground (bushes only, as at Silvies); drawn by the theme's desert_bush painter

chm.label: canopy from the OSIP 2024 photo (heights estimated)
chm.source: Not lidar: no canopy or point cloud reaches the course (DOGAMI canopy/highest-hit services return no data here; the 2011 and 2002 flights have a void; USGS OR_SouthEast_D22 has no tiles in 10TFP 45-46/93-95). Crowns from the Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024 photo by colour (make_photo_canopy.py), heights a dome per crown from its size, 3.5-12 m: estimated, not measured (CLAUDE.md 5.4 step 2, RGB only, lower confidence)
